result.summary: Several layout overflow/clipping issues and one likely text-truncation bug make the home screen look broken.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in “Fastest near you” (Trattoria Piccol…) is cut off at the right edge, including the name and image.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding or make the row clearly scrollable with a peek of the next card so content is not clipped.

issues.description: The restaurant name “Tokumaru Ramen” appears truncated as “Tokumaru Rameı” (last letter cut off).
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap or ellipsize with enough width so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The second “Popular right now” card is cropped by the bottom tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so cards are fully visible when scrolling.

issues.description: Category chips overflow the screen; “Healthy” is clipped and there is no visible scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding and a fade or partial next chip so users can tell the list is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The last letter of “Trattoria Piccol” is also cut off, matching the clipped card.
issues.suggestion: Reserve enough space for titles or use ellipsis after a full visible word.
